scene: A quiet school reading corner. Teacher sits on a low chair at screen-left; Child sits on the rug at screen-right facing her with his hands in his lap. Locked 16:9 medium two-shot with both faces visible.

emotion.baseline: Calm, warm and regulated baseline. Both speak at a normal family volume with small, natural facial movements and gestures.
emotion.allowed_shift: Child tells his story with bright, proud energy; Teacher listens with calm interest and one soft surprised laugh; both end amused and warm.
emotion.forbidden: No exaggerated surprise, wide-eyed shock, bouncing, raised voices, impatience, blaming or teasing. Any disappointment, worry or sadness stays mild and brief, and the adult helps things stay steady.

clips.start: Teacher sits on the low chair; Child sits on the rug facing her with hands in his lap.
clips.action: Teacher opens with the farm news. Child opens both arms wide for so many animals; Teacher leans forward and asks which came first.
clips.end: Child's arms return to his lap; he thinks for a beat.

clips.start: Child's hands rest in his lap while he thinks.
clips.action: Child points off-frame toward an imaginary gate while explaining the goats' house. Teacher asks what they did; Child stacks one fist on the other for the little goat on its mom's back.
clips.end: Child holds the stacked fists briefly; Teacher raises her eyebrows with interest.

clips.start: Child holds the stacked fists; Teacher raises her eyebrows.
clips.action: Teacher repeats the image with wonder. Child slides his top fist down and off with a small bounce for the jump, then spreads his hands like a pool splash; Teacher claps once softly and shakes her head smiling.
clips.end: Child sits tall with hands in his lap, pleased; Teacher rests one hand on her cheek, smiling.
